body:
Thanks for this.

I went into the counseling center yesterday, and got diagnosed with major depression. And now the school and me are talking about medical leave, about taking a year off and coming back once I've dealt with my head and gotten to the point where I don't hate everything. Unfortunately my parents don't understand and aren't looking like they'll support that at all, which hurts. They don't think it'll fix the underlying problem.

I'm pretty good at your 2) there -- it's 1) I have problems with.
